memories.content: Ines is the curator at Marlin Bay gallery. She receives unsolicited portfolios and sometimes replies personally if she finds the work interesting, but often only sends automated acknowledgments. She does not know Yusuf.
Yusuf has a portfolio ready to send to Ines at Marlin Bay gallery via email or postal mail. The gallery has an automated acknowledgment system for incoming submissions.
